correctness.rationale: Complete proof for all integers k>=1. Hub-gathering parity inequalities H>=2k-r, a two-local-move equality-case fix, and activation-ledger bounds delta_0<=k and delta_i<=-1 after hub entry establish the exact threshold. Nonstackability for k>=2 excludes every possible last-activated-petal outcome; k=1 and universal-threshold monotonicity are treated explicitly. Extracted program verified 6125 distinct automorphism orbits across k=1..4, but the proof does not rely on extrapolation.

value.rationale: Gives a sharp nontrivial infinite-family exact stacking number for a new pebbling invariant: friendship graphs for k>=2 have alpha=k and published general lower bound only 3k+1, whereas the proved exact threshold is 4k. The permanent hub-debt argument explains the linear gap and applies uniformly to arbitrary k. The objects are canonical triangle block bouquets, not arbitrary parameter slices; this is not a direct substitution into prior complete multipartite results.
